purpose: Full-stack genealogy and family tree builder with 6 tree visualizations, multi-project support, WhatsApp branch collection with approval queue, offline HTML viewer, PDF poster/multi-page export, and 5,000+ member scalability.

viteMiddleware.hmrDisabledFallback: Keep ws: { server: httpServer } even when DISABLE_HMR=true so reverse-proxy WebSocket connections do not fail

Person.name: string (required)
Person.blood: A+ | A- | B+ | B- | AB+ | AB- | O+ | O- (optional)

moreMenuSections: 1. Theme & Background (Upload 1400px image from gallery, Clear BG, Opacity slider 10%-75%)
2. Quick Tree Design (Normal Type, Circle Design, Circle Orbit, Dream Tree, Radial Fan, Tree Silhouette)

bottomTreeBarControls: Focused Person: Move Left (Elder), Move Right (Younger), Edit & Relationships
Scope toggle: Full Family vs Near Focus (Fast) — auto Near Focus when >250 people

treeDesigns.label: Normal Type
treeDesigns.layout: Top-to-bottom generation rows, 1st Gen centered, children directly below parents, curved cubic paths stemming from couple ♥ badge

treeDesigns.label: Circle Design
treeDesigns.layout: Exact copy of Normal Type top-to-bottom hierarchy
treeDesigns.nodeShape: Circular person representation (116x116px rounded-full with soft white ring)
treeDesigns.background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 18%, #CCFBF1 0%, #DBEAFE 52%, #EDE9FE 100%) on canvas; soft sky [224, 242, 254] in PDF

treeDesigns.label: Circle Orbit
treeDesigns.layout: Concentric orbital shells (Nucleus, K, L, M...) with 360deg/N angular spacing
treeDesigns.colorPattern: Copied from Radial Fan cosmic neon palette: dark space backdrop (#070D1F / #0B1530 / #132554), dashed spokes & stars, 4-color neon borders (Cyan #22D3EE, Pink #F472B6, Yellow #FACC15, Purple #C084FC), neon pink ♥ couple badge

treeDesigns.label: Dream Tree
treeDesigns.layout: Bottom-up tiers (Root -> Bole/Trunk -> Limb -> Branches -> Twigs)
treeDesigns.behavior: Forces Bisected Couple Circles (126x126px) and enables dragging nodes freely

treeDesigns.label: Radial Fan
treeDesigns.layout: Bottom-center root radiating upward in semi-circular arcs (-162deg to -18deg)
treeDesigns.colorPattern: Dark cosmic radial backdrop, family title + generation count header, glowing #BAE6FD Bezier links, 4-color neon circular nodes (#22D3EE, #F472B6, #FACC15, #C084FC)

treeDesigns.label: Tree Silhouette
treeDesigns.layout: Bottom central trunk, angled branches, 210 golden-angle phyllotaxis stipple leaves
treeDesigns.colorPattern: Warm parchment #F7F4EE backdrop, charcoal trunk #1C1917, 4 organic ink palettes

exportAndBackup.designSelectionRule: NEVER ask for Single-Page Tree Design during PDF export; automatically use the last selected Tree Design persisted in localStorage (human_connect_tree_design_v1).
pdfModes: Multi-Page Chart (A4 wrapped text cards + page numbers)
exportAndBackup.standaloneHtmlViewer: Single offline .html file with Directory Search, Relationship Finder, Blood Donors & Phone Directory, respecting all privacy flags and escaping HTML.

scaleOptimizations5000Plus: Precompute O(1) Map indexes (parentsByChild, childrenByParent, activeSpouseByPerson) — zero nested per-person scans
Use index-pointer BFS queues instead of Array.shift()
Replace Math.min(...arr)/Math.max(...arr) spreads with loops to avoid call-stack overflow
Reserve top headerPt band in single-page PDF so oversized trees never overlap or clip header/legend
Scale PDF font sizes (min 0.35pt) and line widths (min 0.1pt) proportionally and skip photos when node scale < 4pt
Detect JPEG/PNG/WEBP headers accurately and deduplicate image aliases in jsPDF
Delay URL.revokeObjectURL by 60 seconds on downloads
Cap standalone HTML viewer directory/blood cards at 300, lazy-render secondary tabs, and cap Relationship dropdowns at 400 filtered options
